claims.text: A valid auth token sent in the `Authorization` header with the prefix `bearer` in any letter case (for example `bearer `, `BEARER ` or `bEaReR `) authenticates the request the same as the prefix `Bearer `.
A valid auth token sent with the exact prefix `Bearer `, or with no prefix at all, still authenticates the request.
A request whose `Authorization` header carries an invalid token is still not authenticated, whatever the letter case of its prefix.
